description: This file configures cookie settings and authentication cookie parameters for an ASP.NET Core web application. It defines constants for cookie validity and name, and provides an extension method to set up cookie policies and application cookies, including security settings and event handling.

classes.name: ConfigureCookieSettings
classes.description: A static class that contains configuration constants and an extension method to setup cookie-related settings and services.

methods.name: AddCookieSettings
methods.description: Extension method for IServiceCollection to configure cookie policies and authentication cookie options, and register related services.
